paths.name: @/lib/db
paths.message: Actions must stay thin. Get prisma from @/lib/action-context (staffContext/studentContext) and delegate data access to lib/repo or lib/domain. See .claude/skills/system-architecture.

patterns.message: Actions must not import prisma. Pass cx.prisma to a lib/repo or lib/domain function; keep prisma types out of the action layer. See .claude/skills/system-architecture.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Actions must not run prisma queries directly — pass prisma to a lib/repo or lib/domain function instead. See .claude/skills/system-architecture.
